news.title: Would you want a SaaS platform that predicted future price movement reliably?
news.summary:
Lets say there was a SaaS platform that tracked your favorite assets and issued a probabilistic analysis every day that gave you a strong indication of which way the price was going to go, over certain time horizons (IE - 24h, 7day, 30 day, 90 day, 1 year).

Is that something you would actually want?

*Assuming it shared its results and scorecard with you so you could clearly see how often the system was "right" or "wrong" for you
